name: github-mcp
description: GitHub's official remote MCP server: repositories, issues, pull requests, actions and code search for development and project workflows.

secrets.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
secrets.description: Fine-grained token for the repositories the agent may read or update. Leave unset to install the connector without connecting it.

github.description: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, actions runs and code search through the official remote MCP server.
github.instruction: Use for repository and project questions: read files, search code, inspect issues/pull requests or check Actions. Read-only unless the token was granted write scopes.
